name: Acrid Thresh
description: Trace a sideways figure eight with the head so each loop sets up the next blow.

name: Raw Wheel
description: Pass the haft from one hand to the other mid-orbit so the head keeps circling without a gap.

name: Padded Swingarm
description: Stop the orbit by planting the haft upright and letting the chain wrap close as a guard.

name: Threshhurdle
description: Step into the opponent's reach while the head circles so the first blow arrives with the foot.

name: Acrid Swingthru
description: Drive the orbit from the wrist alone while the forearm stays still and the elbow stays covered.

name: Genial Hingecap
description: Feel the orbit's rhythm through the haft and mark the exact beat where the opponent's guard drops.

name: Dire Rebound
description: Climb the orbit in a widening spiral from knee to temple and release the head at the top.

name: Sturdy Handstaff
description: Spin the head fast in a vertical ring so darts and thrusts are flicked away from the body.

name: Viselike Swivel
description: Cast one loop of chain over a wrist or weapon and haul back to take the limb out of line.

name: Clutching Lashout
description: Unwind a snared chain with a quick counter-turn of the haft before the opponent can strip it.

name: Flailhasp
description: Slip the haft between the chain and a seizing hand to pry the grip off the links.

name: Resolute Spikehead
description: Wind one turn of chain around the gripping wrist so the haft cannot be knocked loose.

name: Prowling Flailhead
description: Pivot as the chain tightens so the opponent is dragged off his feet toward the swing.

name: Gimbalcordial
description: Lay the chain lightly across an opponent's weapon to feel which way it means to pull.

name: Levering Headball
description: Wrap the chain twice around a rival haft and lean on it to pin the weapon down and away.

name: Cramping Thresh
description: Fling a chain loop over the opponent's shoulders and haul sharply to stagger him forward into the swing.

name: Flailscorer
description: Let a seized chain go slack then whip the head around the grabbing arm into the ribs.

name: Threshflog
description: Launch a rising swing from the low guard that rolls into a falling swing without a pause.

name: Rooted Chainring
description: Hold the head low beside the rear knee with the haft angled up to cover the front.

name: Draught Flailhead
description: Cross the gap in two quick steps with the head swinging out ahead of the body.

name: Discord Rebound
description: Fake a haft jab to the face then fling the head low at the exposed knee.

name: Brassgimbal
description: Steer the swinging head by pulling the chain with the rear hand to bend its path around a guard.

name: Poise Linkband
description: Catch an incoming thrust on the chain and return the head along the same line.

name: Clay Swingthru
description: Carry the full weight of the head over the shoulder and drop it with a stamp onto the opponent's guard.

name: Staticgimbal
description: Swing the head like a pendulum across the front in opposite directions twice then drive it home.

name: Grit Spikehead
description: Slip a half pace sideways and swing in the same breath so the head lands before the reply.

name: Honed Wheel
description: Strike low at the leg to draw the guard down then bring the head high to the temple.

name: Rough Linkband
description: Loft the head up and over a raised shield rim to fall on the shoulder behind it.

name: Lashout Prop
description: Hook the chain around the shield's edge and pull its face away from the body.

name: Looping Flog
description: Swing the head under the lower shield edge into the ankle of the man behind it.

name: Swivelbarrier
description: Jam the haft against the shield boss to stop a shove before it drives the line forward.

name: Flailstalk
description: Retreat one pace as shields close so the line overreaches and opens a seam.

name: Ruthless Hingecap
description: Whip the head around the shield's outer edge so it lands on the bracing arm.

name: Gagging Handstaff
description: Wedge the haft behind the rim and heave to drag the shield aside.

name: Swivel Flog
description: Halt the swing midway and send the head back along the line it came from.

name: Emberswivel
description: Fling the head out and haul it straight back so it strikes once on each leg.

name: Clay Chainlink
description: Reverse the swing close to the body so the elbow and flank stay covered throughout.

name: Swingarm Zip
description: Spin on the lead foot as the swing reverses so the body faces the new direction.

name: Static Looping
description: Tap the head down on the backswing onto a hand reaching for the chain.

name: Gimbalbandage
description: Count the swing's turning point with the breath and find the instant of least weight.

name: Flailhead Hammerfall
description: Snap the swing back on itself at full speed so it lands twice within one beat.

name: Gimbalprop
description: Let the head seem to retreat before reversing into the gap the opponent has stepped into.

name: Wheelslap
description: Reverse twice in a row so the head describes an S across the opponent's front.

name: Threshcurl
description: Run at a diagonal past a spear point and swing the head into the shaft hand.

name: Knitting Chainring
description: Judge a blade's reach by the opponent's stance and set the chain length to match.

name: Threshswat
description: Step inside a long weapon's reach with the chain gathered short and strike from there.

name: Rough Headball
description: Lift the head over a long weapon's point and drop it onto the shaft to pin it.

name: Swingarm Screen
description: Fling the chain around a pole and twist the haft to take it from the opponent's grip.

name: Slinking Chainlink
description: Retreat in step with a pursuing long weapon while the head swings to keep him from closing.

name: Threshslap
description: Pay out every link and swing from the shoulder to hit at the very edge of the chain's reach.

name: Clay Linkband
description: Hold the chain at half length and swing level to the waist at mid distance.

name: Gimbalthwack
description: Grip the chain a hand's breadth from the head and punch it forward into a clinch.

name: Recall Spikehead
description: Tap the head lightly on the ground to learn the exact distance to the opponent's front foot.

name: Swivelscreen
description: Slide the grip along the chain as an attack closes so the guard changes length with it.

name: Veering Rebound
description: Back away while paying out chain so the head keeps the opponent just outside reach.

name: Swingthru Scorer
description: Change the chain length between swings so no two blows arrive at the same distance.

name: Gallwheel
description: Hold the head just beyond the opponent's lunge so it falls short and leaves him open.

name: Brawn Headball
description: Swing the head off a wall or post so it rebounds from an unexpected angle into the target.

name: Acrid Chainlink
description: Let the head bounce off a shield face and snap back into the swing on the same chain.

name: Regimen Hingecap
description: Pull the head home to the guard the instant it touches anything solid.

name: Savage Handstaff
description: Follow a blocked forehand blow with a backhand cut as the head rebounds from the block.

name: Springing Lashout
description: Step back as the head recovers so the weapon and the feet return to guard together.

name: Lunar Chainring
description: Judge from a surface's slant how the head will come off it before the swing is thrown.

name: Rude Wheel
description: Cut straight down with the head while it is still returning from a rising blow.

name: Dire Swivel
description: Chain two rebounds off two surfaces so the head arrives unseen on the opponent's flank.

name: Static Handstaff
description: Strike a held weapon's guard and let the head rebound to hit the knuckles a second time.

name: Swivelthwack
description: Spin the whole body as the head returns so its recovery becomes the next blow.
